name: linux-no-secret-service-degrades-custody
purpose: On a Linux session without a Secret Service, the device credential is kept in a user-only file, diagnostics report degraded custody, and the agent refuses a decision grant.

given.text: the HashRelay cloud is running with workspace w1
no Secret Service is available on the session bus
the HashRelay agent is installed per user on linux

when.text: the person pairs the agent to w1
the person tries to grant one-click decisions to this device
the person opens the agent status

then.text: the device credential is in a file readable only by the user
no decision grant is held by the agent
the status reports degraded credential custody
